scope: 48 baseline partial/unmatched outcomes. Plans are proposed requirements, not claims of missing entire competencies. Two draft prototypes do not close production gaps.

outcomes.observedGap: Counting is supported; one-to-one matching as the comparison method is not established.
outcomes.teachingNeeded: Pair one object from each set; leftovers show more
outcomes.questionsNeeded: Pair unequal and equal sets without numerals
outcomes.visualsNeeded: Two movable object rows with pairing lines
outcomes.acceptance: Verify source method/range, independent answer checks, accessible interaction, fresh practice and educator review before any release claim.
